profile.ja: ふうま八将二車家執事。通称“槍の権左”。剛槍使いで知られる対魔忍。二車骸佐の家に代々仕える執事であり、骸佐の右腕として知られている。執事の職は家中や家来衆をまとめる役職であり、戦闘力よりも知力が求められる職とされるが、権左はまったく真逆。主に命ぜられるままに何の迷いも無く槍の切っ先を向ける狂戦士、それが権左なのである。例え自分の父や母であっても命令とあらば躊躇なく殺す。少なくとも彼を知る者たちにはそう信じられている。
profile.en: He is the Dobashi family's chief retainer of the Fuuma Hachishin Nisha household, also known as "Gonza the Spear". He is a well-known Taimanin for his mastery of the spear. As the chief retainer, he has served the Nisha household for generations and is known as Nisha Gaiza's right-hand man. The position of chief retainer is a role that requires gathering the household and its followers, and is said to require more intelligence than combat strength, but Gonza is the complete opposite. He is a berserker who will point the tip of his spear at anyone without hesitation, as long as he is ordered to do so. He will kill even his own parents if commanded to do so, and those who know him believe this to be true.

text.ja: 土橋権左だ……って知ってるか。なあ宗家のお坊ちゃん
text.en: It's me, Dobashi Gonza... or do you know that already, young master?

text.ja: これは宗家のお坊ちゃん。俺になんか用かい？
text.en: This is the young master of the household. Do you need something from me?

text.ja: ここにいるのは宗家の息がかかった人間ばかりで、居づらいったらないね
text.en: Everyone here is connected to the household, and it's hard to breathe.

text.ja: 良い女が沢山いて目の保養になるのはいいが、どいつもこいつも一癖二癖あるんじゃあなあ……
text.en: It's nice that there are a lot of good-looking women around to soothe my eyes, but every single one of them has their own quirks...

text.ja: あの頃のちっこいガキが今じゃ隊長様ですかい。ふん、大したもんだ
text.en: The little brat from back then is now a captain, huh? Ha, not bad.

text.ja: 俺がお館様と言ったら骸佐様の事だ。あんたじゃあない
text.en: When I say "my lord", I'm referring to Lord Gaiza, not you.

text.ja: 仕方ないとは言え宗家の人間と行動を共にする事になるとはねえ……ま、仕事はきちんとこなすさ
text.en: I never thought I'd be working with someone from the household... but I'll do my job properly, no matter what.

text.ja: 殺せと言われたら殺す、ただの主人の“槍”それが俺だ
text.en: If I'm told to kill, I'll kill - that's all I am, my master's "spear".
